definitions.gloss: to spread; to be rampant; to run rife; to grow thick
definitions.explanation: For something undesirable (weeds, diseases, corruption, etc.) to spread widely and become prevalent.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

- {蔓延|はびこ}らない (negative)
- {蔓延|はびこ}って (te-form)
- {蔓延|はびこ}った (past)

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as はびこる. The kanji {蔓延|はびこ}る uses characters meaning "vine" and "extend," evoking the image of creeping plants.

USAGE:
Almost always used for negative things: weeds, diseases, corruption, bad habits, rumors, etc. Rarely used for positive phenomena.
